metadata.title: Build for RBI, Inherit the EU AI Act — Regulatory Cross-Walk
metadata.author: Pratik Dhanave (Staff Engineer, ClearRoute)

rbi_draft_mrm.name: RBI Draft Model Risk Management Guidance

rbi_free_ai_recommendations.scope: Establish a National Centre of Excellence
AI Innovation Sandbox (runnable offline pipeline with mocked I/O)
Build Indigenous Datasets
Indigenous AI Models & per-message residency enforcement
Capacity Building (sector-wide programs)
Adaptive Policies (declarative YAML & policy DSL)
Inter-regulatory Coordination
Graded Liability (severity grading & auto-incident reporting)
Sectoral AI Code of Conduct (SRO)
Embed AI in Annual Policy Reviews
AI in RBI Supervisory Toolkit
Industry-Regulator Forums
Reportable Incidents Framework (regulator definition)
Board-Approved AI Policy (Annexure V — declarative policy YAML)
Data Lifecycle Governance (encryption, retention, residency & append-only consent)
AI System Governance + Autonomous Systems (risk class, RBAC, caps, circuit breakers)
Product Approval & runtime drift guard (ErrRiskChanged, ErrExpired)
Consumer Protection & AI disclosure on first event
Cybersecurity (authn, RBAC, prompt-injection, PII & explainability guards)
Red Teaming (OWASP ASI-tagged adversarial corpus on every PR)
BCP for AI (deterministic fallbacks & automated failover drills)
AI Incident Reporting (Annexure VI & tamper-evident SHA-256 audit log)
AI Inventory generated directly from live runtime registry
AI Audit Framework (pinned-key Ed25519 signed exports, AIBOM & independent verification)
Disclosures (public disclosure endpoint & first-event AI notice)
AI Toolkit (7-Sutra scorecard, safety chain & dual evidence packs)

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: SHA-256 chain anchored to external timestamp; reports broken chain transparently

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.control: Annexure VI incident form (RBI prescribed AI-incident report)

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: Pre-dispatch enforcement including ErrRiskChanged drift guard
Accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity regression gate mapped to OWASP Agentic Top 10

EU AI Act Article 50 has been binding law since 2 August 2026 (legacy provider watermarking grace ends 2 December 2026; Annex III High-Risk deferred to 2 December 2027 under Digital Omnibus Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)
Versioned, board-approved Quality Management System configuration

rbi_draft_mrm_scorecard.requirement: Full model inventory, nothing running outside it
Risk tiering by materiality, complexity and autonomy
Accountable for a vendor's model, certified or not
Inventory kept 10 years, including decommissioned models
